name: Bulk Confirm Quotations
description: The Bulk Confirm Quotations module for Odoo simplifies the sales workflow by allowing users to confirm multiple quotations in just one click. Instead of processing quotations individually, sales teams can save time and effort by converting several quotations into sale orders at once, making it ideal for businesses handling high volumes of daily quotations. The module integrates seamlessly with the Odoo Sales app, ensuring confirmed quotations automatically follow the standard workflow for deliveries and invoicing. With user access controls, error handling, and notifications, this solution improves efficiency, reduces manual work, and accelerates the overall sales process.
